metric_note: Precision, recall and specificity use only the human labels 'present' and 'missing'. Uncertain, extraction-failure, not-applicable and pending cells are counted and excluded. Definitions: analysis-plan.md, sections 7 to 10; settings.analysis_plan records whether the plan is adopted.

detector.commit_status: not recorded: findings-pseudonymous.json names no detector commit, and the Detector row of analysis-plan.md section 2 names no generating commit yet (step 0.4)

analysis_plan.reason: the banner of analysis-plan.md says 'DRAFT, not adopted'

settings.clopper_pearson: exact binomial tails, 0.025 in each tail
settings.f1: 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN), which equals the harmonic mean of precision and recall where both are defined and positive; undefined only when 2TP + FP + FN = 0

bootstrap.resampling: percentile bootstrap: each replicate draws as many clusters (documents, or offerors in S2a) as the set has, with replacement, by random.Random(seed).randrange, and pools their cells; clusters in ascending order of their lowest WP number; a new generator with the same seed for every bootstrap
bootstrap.quantiles: linear interpolation between order statistics (Hyndman and Fan 1996, type 7, the default of R's quantile() and numpy.percentile) at 0.025 and 0.975
bootstrap.zero_denominator: replicates with a zero denominator are dropped and counted per proportion

settings.headline_rule: The headline interval is the wider of the Wilson interval and the document-cluster bootstrap interval (upper minus lower bound, rounded to six decimals; the Wilson interval on a tie). If more than the maximum fraction of bootstrap replicates is dropped for a zero denominator, or the bootstrap is undefined, the Wilson interval is the headline (analysis-plan.md section 9).
settings.calibration_rule: an in-sample calibration document is the document whose every cell carries the note 'calibration' (analysis-plan.md section 4); it is excluded from every analysis set
settings.sensitivity_base: S2 to S4 vary the primary set
settings.per_rule_published_for: the primary set only; S1's per-rule counts go to --internal-out, because S1 differs from the primary set only by WP-007

primary.detector_flags_reason: withheld while any cell is pending: analysis-plan.md section 5 takes this count from the findings file after labelling, and the summary carries no detector outcome while labelling is open
